enchantments.tooltip: +4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Bleeding 3: This weapon is wickedly curved, with spines and hooks meant to cause damage to those with flesh. This weapon does 3d8 bleeding damage to those that are vulnerable to it.
Doublestrike 7%: Passive: 7% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
